rationale: Independent PO review based on direct source code inspection. The delivery is functionally sound — protocol v1.0.0 is well-structured, RPOPLPUSH atomic operation correctly prevents message loss, TaskClaim with Lua compare-and-swap ensures safe release, and the injection-safe --query-file approach eliminates shell injection risk. CI is green (Lint+Typecheck+Test SUCCESS, CodeQL SUCCESS). However, the following critical issues prevent approval: (1) Redis credentials hardcoded in 5 source files exposed in git history, (2) tautological assertion (returncode is not None) provides false confidence, (3) STARTED state not explicitly verified, (4) no real external effects check, (5) chain-of-validation violated — PR merged by developer without independent PO review. Follow-up PR required.

observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 5 source files — exposed in git history. If repository becomes public or logs leak, credential is compromised.
observations.recommendation: Remove all hardcoded defaults. Use os.environ['REDIS_PASS'] (mandatory, fail-fast). Rotate exposed credential immediately. Create ticket for secrets manager migration.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess — does not verify success
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay execution success

observations.description: STARTED state not explicitly checked. Issue #697 requires RECEIVED → ACCEPTED → STARTED → COMPLETED chain verification.
observations.recommendation: Add explicit assertion: verify task:<task_id> exists with state='STARTED' before COMPLETED transition

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST=172.16.12.2 and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded with silent fallback — masks misconfiguration
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production mode; separate test mode with explicit opt-in

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True — no real verification that task produces no side effects
observations.recommendation: Assert no git changes (git status --porcelain), no file writes outside test/tmp directories

observations.description: TaskClaim.extend() method exists but is never called during run_task(). If task execution exceeds CLAIM_TTL (300s), claim expires and another relay could double-execute.
observations.recommendation: Implement heartbeat thread calling claim.extend() every 60s during execution, or align CLAIM_TTL with run_budget + margin
